node.label: alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase deficiency type 1
node.definition: Alpha-N-acetylgalactosaminidase (NAGA) deficiency type 1 is a very rare and severe type of NAGA deficiency characterized by infantile neuroaxonal dystrophy.
